core.headline: Mill Cottage, a detached c.1850 cottage on the River Beult
core.summary: A detached cottage dating from c.1850, standing on Riverside Lane in Yalding with gardens extending to the riverbank, exposed beams and a wood-burning stove. Oil-fired central heating, driveway parking and septic tank drainage.
core.listing:
Mill Cottage stands on Riverside Lane in Yalding, a detached cottage dating from c.1850 with gardens extending to the bank of the River Beult. Inside, exposed beams and a wood-burning stove provide character, while oil-fired central heating serves the accommodation.

The cottage offers three bedrooms and two bathrooms, with two reception rooms. A driveway provides off-street parking.

The garden extends to the riverbank, a particular feature of this setting.

Yalding is a village with a pub and primary school.

The property is offered freehold for offers in excess of £575,000. Council Tax band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction is standard. Mains electricity and mains water (metered) are connected. Sewerage is via septic tank. Heating is oil-fired central heating. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway.

The ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020. Flood doors and non-return valves were fitted in 2021. The property is insured through a Flood Re-backed policy.

Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.

emailBlast.headline: Mill Cottage, Riverside Lane, Yalding ME18
emailBlast.body:
A three-bedroom detached cottage from c.1850 on Riverside Lane in Yalding, with exposed beams, a wood-burning stove and a garden running down to the River Beult.

You enter into a hall with exposed beams overhead. The two reception rooms each have character, one warmed by a wood-burning stove. The kitchen opens to the garden. Upstairs, three bedrooms are served by two bathrooms. Outside, the garden extends to the riverbank, and the driveway provides parking.

Offers in Excess of £575,000, freehold. Council tax band E (Maidstone Borough Council). EPC rating E. The ground floor flooded from the River Beult in December 2013 and February 2020; flood doors and non-return valves fitted 2021; insured through a Flood Re-backed policy. Sewerage is to a septic tank. Heating is oil-fired central heating.

Full material information is on the property listing.
